user.title: Connect existing MVHR telemetry
user.description: Use an already configured Wi-Fi unit and its existing TLS credentials. Saving starts one read-only MQTT connection. This integration does not pair the unit, change its settings, or provide an electronics-temperature measurement. Stop the previous add-on first.
